title: Early warning for distributor stock-outs
summary: An FMCG manufacturer finds out too late which distributor is about to run out, and why. Alerts did not yet beat the existing forecast, but the suggested order cut stock-out days by 13–30%. Next step: an 8-week pilot at 2–3 distributors.
data_note: Hypothetical scenario on demo data, checked on 3 public datasets

title: How many loaves to bake each morning
summary: A bakery bakes by last year's sales and loses money to both leftovers and shortages. I framed the problem, set pass criteria up front and tested AI against the manual method. Recommendation: a 2–3 shop pilot for a chain, not a single-shop rollout.
data_note: Hypothetical scenario on public Kaggle data
